intro: Lost Relic Carry involves recovering a fractured piece of an ancient rock-mech automaton and delivering it to Prospector Whelgar in the Wetlands. The relic's unknown composite material hints at the sophisticated engineering of the Titans, earning serious reverence from dwarven researchers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You pick up a fractured piece of the rock-mech automaton. It has a texture unlike anything you've touched before, a composite material of unknown makeup. This is certainly bound to be more 'device' than 'debris.'
Prospector Whelgar himself at his excavation site might have something useful to share about the relic.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, ye ventured all the way in and survived to tell the tale?! Let's have a look at what ye carry there.
Well, knowing what ye went through to bring it back to me, I think it warrants a certain reverence for your artifact.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
